top_signals.title: Crypto’s Trump-Fueled Washington Boom Reaches Its Endgame
top_signals.summary: Crypto’s extraordinary run of political good fortune in Washington has come to an abrupt halt. With Democrats set to control Congress following their midterm sweep, the industry faces the prospect of tougher rules and closer scrutiny of its ties to President Donald Trump.
